name: avoid creating duplicate top-level resources
definition: Ensure exactly one instance of the named resource is created (no extra copies from retries or idempotency failures).
failure_mode: Multiple identical resources created, breaking lookup or the single-spreadsheet requirement.

name: avoid specific helper-search tokens in final proofs
definition: complete all intended searches to concrete tactic statements leaving none of the disallowed auto-search tokens anywhere
failure_mode: a left-internally token in a proof or comment fails the scan

name: build a compiler from source for the host and compile/run with it
definition: Correct the compiler build to the host OS/ISA, build it, and use it to compile/run C programs.
failure_mode: A mismatched host/ISA configuration yields a non-runnable compiler or build errors.

name: build a compressed initramfs (busybox, device nodes, init program) that boots to a shell
definition: Assemble a gzipped cpio or busybox rootfs/ramdisk from a descriptor manifest including an init script, device nodes and busybox.
failure_mode: Missing init, busybox, or device nodes prevents reaching a shell.
